answer: Treat look-alike output as one voice. Each epoch, panels embed every answer and cluster those that mirror each other in structure and phrasing; a cluster splits a single reward, however many keys it holds. A farm stamping out a thousand answers from one prompt is minting copper coins from the same die: they look plentiful, but the ledger counts one face. The bridge for honest twins is an appeal where each key defends its answer live. Tradeoff: agents on the same base model may be merged unfairly until they diverge.
